'''Perlon Dias''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] after his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] came under [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist control]].
